messages:
sam: Quick heads-up: were retiring DeployBot and switching production release routing to the new `release-broker` service on 2026-04-12. Planned maintenance window 2026-04-12 01:00 -> 2026-04-12 06:00 UTC.

ana: Why now? release-broker supports region-aware canaries, automatic rollback, and a signing + attestation step that integrates with our new policy engine. Also removes a legacy token store.

lina: What breaks for integrators? The webhook schema changes and the auth mechanism moves from static deploy tokens to short-lived mTLS client certs issued by the broker CA. Well provide a shim for 7 days.

ops-oncall: Canary plan? I want to avoid traffic hits to partner integrations.

sam: Canary order: internal infra -> platform tooling -> customer-facing services -> partner integrations. First canary publish 02:00 UTC with a single service (platform-registry). Monitor 30m, then widen.

ana: Auth migration notes: if you call DeployBot with X-Deploy-Token, switch to mutual TLS. Example client config (curl):

```
curl --cert client.pem --key client.key \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"release":"v2.3.1","strategy":"canary"}' \ 
  https://release-broker.redwood-internal/api/v1/releases
```

sam: For GitHub -> DeployBot integration (legacy webhook), well auto-forward to the broker for 7 days. After 7 days we will return 410. Please update integrations ASAP.

lina: Is there a compatibility mode? We need to support partner integrations that cannot rotate keys quickly.

ana: Compatibility mode: broker exposes a per-org short-lived proxy token for partners (valid 48h) and a managed client cert issuance flow. Partners must register at the partner onboarding page.

deploy-bot: NOTICE: DeployBot service will be read-only from 2026-04-12T00:00Z, and fully decommissioned 2026-04-19T00:00Z.

ops-oncall: Runbook reminders: keep infra-oncall paged during the window; escalation path: ops-oncall -> sam -> ana. If broker becomes degraded, flip `release-routing` flag to fallback (reverts to deploybot-proxy).

sam: Migration checklist (short): 1) update deploy clients to mTLS or use proxy token, 2) swap release endpoints, 3) validate canary traffic, 4) verify signing attestation in console, 5) label repos as migrated. Full checklist link will be in #devex.

lina: Logs: broker returns structured events now. Example event snippet: `{ "event_type":"release.started","service":"platform-registry","region":"us-west-2","canary":true }`  please update alert parsers.

ana: Monitoring: new dashboards in ReleaseOps (latency, success-rate, attestation-failures). Well add alerts for attestation >=3% or canary failure rate >1%.

sam: Rollback plan: if we see regression during the window, ops flips feature flag to route to deploybot-proxy (read-only mode still serves releases) while we revert cert rotation. Full rollback steps in runbook.

lina: Who needs to be contacted for partner exceptions? Partners must open an onboarding ticket and well issue a 48h proxy token. SecOps will review long-term exceptions.

ops-oncall: Ive scheduled pages for the window. Ill also post a narrow alert stream to #release-war-room during migration.

sam: ETA for the migration doc and PR templates: noon PT today. Ill attach the broker client library examples and the Cert Authority CSR flow.

ana: Also: update runbooks for incident commander; add a step to confirm attestation logs are present for each release.

lina: thx all  testing the sample client now, will report any issues in this thread.

sam: Thanks team. Expect the traffic cutover to be automated but monitored. Tag @sam/@ana if urgent. :rocket:
